'''''Hispidella''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/721569#page/141/mode/1up Lamarck, Jean-Baptiste Pierre Antoine de Monet de. 1789.  Encyclopédie Méthodique, Botanique 3: 134] short description in Latin, longer description and commentary in French</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40026426 Tropicos, ''Hispidella'' Barnadez ex Lam.]</ref> The genus is [[monotypic]] with only one known species, '''''Hispidella hispanica''''', native to the [[Iberian Peninsula]] ([[Portugal]] and [[Spain]]).<ref name=x/>
